channel.title: Antony Clements — Notes on AI-augmented software engineering
channel.description: Essays and notes by Antony Clements on AI-augmented software engineering.

item.title: Code Without a Theory
item.description: AI agents produce code without building Naur's theory — and the review process built for human-scale code can't keep up. On the flipped cost of writing versus reviewing, the review ratchet, and what actually holds up.
